title: Methods
description: Research methods grouped by their main problem, with shared papers linked where contributions overlap.

children.title: Visual Perception & Representations
children.description: Embeddings, objects, tracks, states, relations and event descriptions extracted from visual observations.

children.title: Memory Construction
children.description: What is retained across observations, and how that retained evidence is maintained.

children.title: Semantic memory
children.description: Consolidated facts and recurring relationships. These are shared references to semantic components of mixed-memory systems.

children.title: Entity-centric memory
children.description: Persistent identities, object locations and histories, and relationships between entities.

children.title: Episodic & event memory
children.description: Timestamped experiences, events and contextual records retained for later use.

children.title: Mixed memory
children.description: Systems that combine episodic, entity-centric or semantic memory. Multiple input modalities alone do not imply mixed memory.

children.title: Memory maintenance
children.description: Retaining and compressing visual context and caches. Bounded GPU context does not imply bounded total storage.

children.title: Video Retrieval & RAG
children.description: Find videos, moments or memory records, select evidence, and execute video queries. Retrieval does not necessarily generate an answer.

children.title: VideoQA & Reasoning
children.description: Answer and reason over video evidence, including grounded answers, abstention and streaming responses.

children.title: Assessment & Monitoring
children.description: Understand execution and assess it against procedural, quality, progress or safety criteria.

children.title: Procedural understanding & errors
children.description: Recognize steps and dependencies, track completion, and identify or explain execution mistakes.

children.title: Quality & progress assessment
children.description: Estimate progress and completion or compare execution quality against goals and human judgments.

children.title: Anomalies, safety & compliance
children.description: Detect unusual events or assess visible evidence against safety requirements. Anomaly, mistake and hazard labels are not interchangeable.

title: Robotics
description: Robot-centered learning, memory, evaluation and surveys. RL for a video-QA controller remains in Methods.

children.title: Learning, rewards & feedback
children.description: Visual rewards, preferences, policy learning and annotation for robot training. Includes explicitly adjacent foundations.

children.title: Robot memory & understanding
children.description: Memory and reasoning over a robot’s observed experience.

children.title: Datasets & benchmarks
children.description: Robot-focused resources, separated from general video-understanding datasets.

children.title: Surveys
children.description: Overviews of transferring video experience into robot learning.

title: Datasets & Benchmarks
description: Resources grouped by task, camera/video type or evaluation format. A benchmark measures a task, not a required memory architecture.

title: Surveys & Studies
description: Literature syntheses and diagnostic studies, kept separate from proposed methods.

children.title: Surveys
children.description: Research taxonomies and literature reviews.

children.title: Empirical & diagnostic studies
children.description: Diagnostic findings without a proposed new method.

title: Systems & Business Solutions
description: Complete research workflows, commercial products, reference platforms and video-processing infrastructure.

children.title: End-to-end research systems
children.description: Integrated research workflows. Offline prototypes, field evaluations and author-reported deployments are not equivalent.

children.title: Products & platforms
children.description: Solutions documented in the wiki business catalog. Vendor descriptions are not independent evaluations.

children.title: Video analytics infrastructure
children.description: Frame filtering, configuration and resource scheduling for video workloads.
